overview_description.description: Lucible operates a consumer financial platform that combines checking and investing in a single account. The company enables users to connect existing bank accounts and have idle balances automatically invested in an S&P 500 index. When users make purchases or transfers, Lucible issues margin loans in real time using the investment portfolio as collateral to fund the transaction. This structure is designed to maintain market exposure while preserving day-to-day spending access. Lucible charges a transparent subscription fee and applies interest on margin lending instead of taking spreads on deposited cash. The service targets retail investors seeking to apply strategies traditionally used by high net worth investors to everyday finances.
